visual.general_description: Line graph of valproate concentration against hours after admission with labelled L-Carnitine arrows, two HDF bars and a printed therapeutic-range label.
visual.detailed_description: A single line graph with a connected line and circular markers and no panel letters. The y-axis is titled "Valproate concentration (μmol/L)" with printed tick labels 0, 500, 1000 and 1500. The x-axis is titled "Hours after admission" with printed tick labels 0, 20, 40 and 60. Above the plot area, three downward-pointing arrows sit under the printed label "L-Carnitine". Below those arrows are two separate short horizontal bars, each labelled "HDF", with a gap between them. Two horizontal dotted lines run across the plot, and the printed text "Therapeutic range of valproate" stands to the right of them. The plotted line has eight circular markers: it starts flat across its first two markers, then falls steeply through the next markers and flattens again toward its last markers. No numeric data labels are printed on the line or markers.

visual.general_description: Flowchart of a systematic literature review search with boxes of printed record counts and arrows leading to eight included studies.
visual.detailed_description: A vertical flowchart of text boxes joined by arrows, with no panel letters. Two boxes at the top read "51 records identified through MEDLINE" with "83 record identified through Web of Science" in the first box, and "0 additional records identified through other sources" in the second. Lines from both join and lead by an arrow to the box "54 records after duplicates removed", which leads by an arrow to the box "54 records screened". From the screened box an arrow points right to a box reading "41 records excluded" with the sub-items "33 irrelevant to the topic", "6 reviews", "1 article in Japanese" and "1 article in Finnish". A second arrow leads downward from the screened box to the box "13 full-text articles assessed for eligibility". From that box an arrow points right to a box reading "5 full-text articles excluded" with the sub-items "1 used supportive care only", "1 did not report intoxication" and "3 additional reviews were identified". A downward arrow leads from the assessed box to the final box "8 studies included in qualitative synthesis".
